'''Fudbalski klub Tuzla City''' ({{lit|Football Club Tuzla City}}), formerly known as '''Fudbalski klub Sloga Simin Han''', is a professional [[Football team|football club]] based in [[Simin Han]], [[Tuzla]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The club competes in the [[Second League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] (North), the third tier of football in the country."}}
